# Fitting GAMM

```{r}
dat<-read_parquet("data/dog_nonverbal_communication_samplereport_ds.parquet")
dat3 <- dat %>%
  filter(!(subject %in% c("Ace", "Filou", "Floki", "George", "Ignaz", "Jimi", "Lenny", "Sahibu", "Sheila", "Timo", "Zserbo"))) %>% # include only dogs with all 4 valid trials (1 per condition)
droplevels()

levels(as.factor(dat3$session_number))
table(dat3$subject, dat3$session_number)
length(unique(levels(as.factor(dat3$subject)))) #28 subjects left
summary(dat3$time)
```


```{r}
# Defining events (time series):
dat3$Event <- interaction(dat3$subject, dat3$condition, dat3$session_number, drop=TRUE)
levels(dat3$Event)

library(mgcv)
gamm.full2 <- bam(pupil_base ~ trial_type + session_number + 
           s(time, k=20) + 
           s(time, by= trial_type, k=20) +
             #argument by: fit different smooths for different levels of a categorical variables (factor-smooth interaction)
           s(Xgaze_RIGHT, Ygaze_RIGHT) +
           s(time, subject, bs='fs', m=1)+
           s(time, Event, bs='fs', m=1), 
           #bs="fs" is for random wiggly curves: produces a smooth curve for each level of a single factor, treating the curves as entirely random
           data=dat3, discrete=TRUE, nthreads=40, method="ML") 

summary(gamm.full2)

library(mgcViz)
gam.check(gamm.full2)


acf(resid(gamm.full2), bty='n', main="ACF residuals model1")
acf(resid(gamm.full2), plot=FALSE)
```


```{r}
#save gam_check
#remotes::install_github("m-clark/visibly")
library(visibly)
png("./plots/pupil_gamm.full_gam_check.png", units="cm", res=600, width=24, height = 18)
gam_check_plot<-plot_gam_check(gamm.full2, scatter=TRUE)
print(gam_check_plot)
dev.off()

png("plots/pupil_gamm.full_acf_plot.png", units="cm", res=600, width=12, height = 12)
acf_plot<-acf(resid(gamm.full2), bty='n', main="")
print(acf_plot)
dev.off()
```

* Summed effects
```{r}
plot_smooth(gamm.full2, view="time", cond=list(trial_type="cong"), rm.ranef=TRUE,
  v0=0, col="black", lwd=2, lty=6, rug=FALSE, se=1.96,
  main="Estimated effects", ylab="Pupil (baselined)", las=1)

plot_smooth(gamm.full2, view="time", cond=list(trial_type="incong"), rm.ranef=TRUE,
  v0=0, col="black", lwd=2, lty=6, rug=FALSE, se=1.96,
  main="Estimated effects", ylab="Pupil (baselined)", las=1)

```

```{r}
tmp <- gamm.full2$model
plot_modelfit(gamm.full2, view="time", event=tmp$Event,n = 2)
```


## Aggregate data

```{r}
dat3_agg <- dat3 %>%
  group_by(subject, trial_type) %>%
  summarise(mean_pup = mean(pupil_base))

dat3_agg  %>%
  group_by( trial_type) %>%
  summarise(mean_pupil_size = mean(mean_pup), se = sd(mean_pup)/sqrt(length(mean_pup)))
```


```{r}
# Convert to wide format
dat3_wide <- dat3_agg %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = trial_type, 
    values_from = mean_pup
  )

# Paired t-test
t_test_result <- t.test(
  dat3_wide$cong,
  dat3_wide$incong,
  paired = TRUE
)

```
Assumptions violated? --> Yes
```{r}
# Create a difference score
dat3_wide <- dat3_wide %>%
  mutate(diff_score = cong - incong)  

## 1. Shapiro-Wilk normality test on difference scores
shapiro_test <- shapiro.test(dat3_wide$diff_score)
print(shapiro_test)
```

##Wilcoxon test
```{r}
library(exactRankTests)
better.wilc=function(var1, var2){
  #running the test:
  wr=wilcox.exact(var1, var2,
    exact=T, paired=T)
  N=sum(var1!=var2)#determine sample size
  wT=wr$statistic
  wT=max(c(wT, N*(N+1)/2-wT))
  return(data.frame(T.plus=wT,
    N=N, number.ties=sum(var1==var2), P=wr$p.value))
}
better.wilc(dat3_wide$cong,   dat3_wide$incong)
```


#GAMM with all dogs included, even those without a full dataset and even trials with gaze >70% were included
```{r}
# Defining events (time series):
dat2<-read_parquet("data/dog_nonverbal_communication_samplereport_ds_ALL_DATA.parquet")
dat2$Event <- interaction(dat2$subject, dat2$condition, dat2$session_number, drop=TRUE)
levels(dat2$Event)

library(mgcv)
gamm.full <- bam(pupil_base ~ trial_type + session_number + 
           s(time, k=20) + 
           s(time, by= trial_type, k=20) +
             #argument by: fit different smooths for different levels of a categorical variables (factor-smooth interaction)
           s(Xgaze_RIGHT, Ygaze_RIGHT) +
           s(time, subject, bs='fs', m=1) +
           s(time, Event, bs='fs', m=1), 
           #bs="fs" is for random wiggly curves: produces a smooth curve for each level of a single factor, treating the curves as entirely random
           data=dat2, discrete=TRUE, nthreads=40, method="ML") 

summary(gamm.full)

library(mgcViz)
gam.check(gamm.full)


acf(resid(gamm.full), bty='n', main="ACF residuals model1")
acf(resid(gamm.full), plot=FALSE)
```

* difference curve
```{r}
#save data
plot_diff_gamm.full<-plot_diff(gamm.full, view="time", 
           comp=list(trial_type=c("cong", "incong")), rm.ranef=TRUE, 
          las=1, ylab="Est. difference in pupil size", 
          col="black", hide.label = TRUE, plot = FALSE)
plot_diff_gamm.full$time <- plot_diff_gamm.full$time + 5000 #add offset to dataset values to make them correspond to video times

plot_diff_gamm.full<-ggplot(data=plot_diff_gamm.full, aes(x=time, y=est))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)+
  geom_path(lty=2)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x=time, ymin=est-CI, ymax=est+CI), alpha=0.2)+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_x_continuous(name="Video time (ms)", breaks=c(6000, 7000, 8000, 9000, 10000))+ ylab("Est. difference in pupil size")+ggtitle("Congruent - Incongruent (N=39)")+
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank())

plot_diff_gamm.full

ggsave(plot_diff_gamm.full, filename = "plots/pupil_difference_curve_gamm.full_trial_type_N39.png", width=8, height=6, scale=0.6, dpi=600)

```
